ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.16.2 extends the bounded-risk aggressive Reachability playtest to coexist with Hospitality. V0.4.16.1 successfully cleared Pathfinding Framework's diagnostics-only CanReach Postfix, after which runtime compatibility scanning exposed Hospitality's authoritative guest-area Postfix. Source audit shows Hospitality only tightens a successful reachability result from true to false when an arrived guest targets a cell outside its GuestArea. Harmony Postfixes still execute when RimMT supplies a validated profile result from its Prefix, so the guest-area restriction remains downstream and authoritative. V0.4.16.2 therefore whitelists only the exact Orion.Hospitality Reachability_Patch+CanReach.Postfix; all other foreign Reachability patches remain blocking. VFE Phasing and Pathfinding Framework coexistence rules are retained. Fresh profiles still use shadow validation, periodic Vanilla sampling, per-profile cooldown and a global parity fuse. Worker threads do not commit Pawn jobs, reservations or gameplay-state mutations.
